annotations.title: Climeth an other way.
annotations.text: Whosoeuer taketh vpon him to preach without lawful sending, to minister Sacraments, and is not Canonically ordered of a true Catholike Bishop, to be a Curate of soules, Person, Bishop, or what other spiritual Pastor so euer, and commeth not in by lawful election and holy Churches ordinance to that dignity, but breaketh in against order by force or fauour of men, and by humane lawes, he is a theefe and a murderer. ◦ So came in Arius, Caluin, Luther, and al Heretikes: and al that succede them in roome and doctrine. And generally euery one that descendeth not by Lawful succession in the knowen ordinarie line of Catholike Bishops and Pastors that haue been in al Countries since their conuersion. And according to this rule S. Irenaeus li. 3 c. 3. trieth the true shepheards from the theeues and Heretikes. So doe Tertul. de Praescr. nu. 11. S. Cypr. de vnit. Ec. nu. 7. S. August. ep. 165. & cont. ep. Manich. c. 4. and Lirinensis.

notes.text: Arch-heretikes specially, are the theeues that clime in an other way, not by the doore.

annotations.title: Good Pastor.
annotations.text: The good Pastor, is he whose special care is not of his owne aduantage, but of the safty of the flocke. The hireling, is he that respecteth not the profite and good of the flocke, but his owne lucre. The Woulfe is the Heretike, or any persecutor of the Church, which is Christs flocke.

annotations.title: Fleeth.
annotations.text: Euery Bishop and Pastor is bound to abide with his flocke in times of danger and persecution euen to death, ◦ except him self be personally sought for, rather then the flocke, or the flocke it self forsake him. for in such cases the Pastor may flee, as the Apostles did, and S. Athanasius, and others. S. Athan. Apol. de sua fuga. August. ep. 180.

notes.text: When the Pastor must tarie, or may flee.

annotations.title: The dedication.
annotations.text: [1] This is the feast of Dedication instituted by Iudas Machabaeus li. 1 Mach. c. 4. Christ vouchsafed to honour and keepe that feast instituted by him: & our Heretikes vouchsafe not to pray and sacrifice for the dead, [2] vsed and approued by him. The Dedication also of Christian Churches is warranted thereby, with the annual memories thereof. And it proueth that such things may be instituted without any expresse commaundement in Scripture.

annotations.title: That which he gaue me.
annotations.text: Thus read also diuers of the Fathers, namely S. Hilar. Trin. li. 7 post medium. S. Ambr. de Sp. S. li. 3. c. 18. S. August. in Io. tract. 48. S. Cyril. li. 7 in Io. c. 10. and vse it to proue that Christ had his essence and nature of the Father. [1] And therfore some Heretikes of our time wickedly accuse the Councel of Laterane for falsifying this place and applying it to the same purpose. Which they lesse can abide, for that it is against Caluins Autotheisme, [2] holding that Christ tooke his person of the Father, but not his substance. See the 2 Annot. in 1 Io. v. 1.

notes.text: Christs essence & diuine nature of the Father.
